title: Hip-hop backdrops, trap and hyphy: components and forms
doc: C minor throughout so components mix with each other. One cycle = one bar of 4/4 on a 16-step grid. Racks follow docs/RACK_STANDARD.md (hygiene head, class band, gain staging); patterns and form gates are atoms under hh.

atomsIngredient.title: Hip-hop atoms
atomsIngredient.doc: glyphcore/phonk hip-hop atoms (hh.): boom-bap, trap and hyphy drum patterns, hats and rolls, 808 and bass lines, chords, chops, tags; song-form gates (intro, verse, hook, bridge, outro, drop-in, drop bar, last-beat drop, beat switch, bounce, stomp). Import with atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/phonk:atoms-hiphop").

bbKick.doc: boom-bap kick: round sine boom, short pitch knock, light drive

knock808.doc: the phonk kick808 with a 40 Hz scope: at trap tempos (several kicks per bar) its pitch-envelope bursts otherwise leak under 20 Hz

clap.doc: clap: band-passed noise burst around 1.2 kHz

snap.doc: finger snap: short, narrow noise at 2.4 kHz, top rolled off at 5 kHz

openHat.doc: open hat: long noise decay above 7 kHz

bbBass.doc: boom-bap bass: dark triangle, soft attack, mono

rhodes.doc: electric-piano keys: FM sine, ratio 1, decaying index

trapBell.doc: trap bell: FM sine, harmonic ratio 4, no sustain

airPad.doc: cloud pad: triangle, slow attack, low end left to the bass

hyphyLead.doc: hyphy lead: bright square, quick vibrato, short notes

chopStab.doc: chop: short saw chord stab with a filter blip (an MPC-style chopped chord without a sample)

voxTag.doc: vox tag without samples: a short vowel-filtered saw 'hey' (use word() or a vox bank for real tags)

vinyl.doc: vinyl hiss bed: pink noise, band-limited, very low

downlifter.doc: downlifter: noise whose low-pass falls from about 9.6 kHz to 1.2 kHz over two seconds

boomKick.doc: boom-bap kick: 1, the a of 2, the and of 3

boomHats.body: x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x x
boomHats.doc: 8ths with a 16th pickup into the next bar

trapKick.doc: trap kick over two bars, half-time

trapHats.body: <[x*16] [x x x x x x x x x x x x [x x x] [x x x] [x x x x] [x x x x x x]]>
trapHats.doc: 16th hats, every second bar ends in triplet, 32nd and 64th-triplet rolls

trap808.doc: 808 line that follows the trap kick, each note held to the next (legato, as an 808 rings); C2 root for small speakers and no short bursts below 20 Hz

hyphyLead.doc: hyphy lead riff on the bounce

boomChords.doc: Cm7 to Abmaj7, one bar each

trapChords.doc: i VI VII V in C minor

trapBell.doc: bell melody over the trap chords

cloudChords.doc: Ebmaj7 Cm7 Abmaj7 Bbmaj7: slow cloud loop

tag.doc: a tag at the end of the bar

fx.doc: an fx hit at the top of every 4th bar

intro.doc: intro: bars 1-4 (form: intro 4, verse 16, hook 8, verse 16, hook 8, bridge 4, hook 8, outro 4 = 68 bars)

drop.doc: drop-in: the beat enters after the intro

dropBar.doc: drums out for the bar before each hook

lastBeat.doc: drop the beat for the last beat before each hook

switch.doc: beat switch: the second verse changes kit and feel

bounce.doc: hyphy bounce: first half of hooks 1 and 3

stomp.doc: hyphy stomp: second half of hooks 1 and 3, kick and clap on every beat

recipes.title: Boom-bap kick
recipes.intent: Round, knocking kick on 1, the a of 2 and the and of 3.

recipes.title: Clap backbeat
recipes.intent: Band-passed noise clap on 2 and 4.

recipes.title: Trap hats with rolls
recipes.intent: 16th hats with accents; every second bar ends in triplet, 32nd and 64th-triplet rolls.

recipes.title: Open hat on the offbeat
recipes.intent: Long open hat between the beats.

recipes.title: Finger snaps
recipes.intent: Short narrow snaps on every and (hyphy and West Coast).

recipes.title: Trap 808 line
recipes.intent: Sine 808 that follows the trap kick, soft attack, drive for small speakers.

recipes.title: Boom-bap bass
recipes.intent: Dark triangle bass locked to the boom-bap kick.

recipes.title: Electric-piano keys
recipes.intent: Cm7 to Abmaj7 on FM keys.

recipes.title: Trap bell melody
recipes.intent: Bell line over i VI VII V.

recipes.title: Cloud pad
recipes.intent: Slow major-seventh pad, low end left to the bass.

recipes.title: Chopped chord stabs
recipes.intent: MPC-style chopped chord rhythm (3+3+4+2+4) as saw stabs.

recipes.title: Hyphy lead riff
recipes.intent: Bright square riff with quick vibrato on the bounce.

recipes.title: Vox tag (no samples)
recipes.intent: A vowel-filtered saw 'hey' at the end of the bar, for a producer-tag slot.

recipes.title: Vinyl hiss bed
recipes.intent: Quiet band-limited pink-noise bed under a beat.

recipes.title: Downlifter
recipes.intent: Falling noise sweep after an impact.

recipes.title: Boom-bap beat
recipes.intent: Kick, clap, hats, bass and keys in the pocket.

recipes.title: Trap beat
recipes.intent: Half-time clap, rolling hats, 808, bells.

recipes.title: Hyphy bounce into stomp
recipes.intent: Two bars of bounce (3+3+4+3+3 kick, claps, snaps), two bars of stomp (kick and clap on every beat).

recipes.title: Drop bar before the hook
recipes.intent: Drums play three bars and drop out for the fourth, so the hook lands on an empty bar's pickup.
recipes.notes: Plain Strudel uses .mask("<1 1 1 0>"); with hooks the same form is the gate atom hh.dropBar (tagged("drums").mute(atoms.hh.dropBar)).

recipes.title: Drop the beat on beat 4
recipes.intent: Every 4th bar the drums stop for the last beat: a gap that pulls into the next section.
recipes.notes: Plain Strudel masks the last quarter of every 4th bar; with hooks it is the gate atom hh.lastBeat (bar.beat points, 20.4b..21b).

recipes.title: Beat switch
recipes.intent: Two bars boom-bap, then the same harmony over a trap kit: the beat switches, the song does not.
recipes.notes: Plain Strudel alternates kits with masks; with hooks: hooks.bind("kick", "bbKick", "<29b") and hooks.bind("kick", "knock808", atoms.hh.switch).

recipes.title: Switch-up (same kit, new pattern)
recipes.intent: Kit and harmony stay; kick and bass flip to the bounce pattern every 4 bars.

syntax.title: Song form as gates (intro, verse, hook, bridge, outro)
syntax.explain: hh.* gates from the pack; lanes are muted by gate, never copied
syntax.code:
setcpm(90/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/phonk:atoms-hiphop")
hooks.bind("kick", "bbKick"); hooks.bind("snare", "clap"); hooks.bind("keys", "rhodes"); hooks.bind("hat", "hat")
kick: s(atoms.hh.boomKick).use("kick").tags("drums")
snare: s(atoms.hh.boomSnare).use("snare").tags("drums")
hats: s(atoms.hh.boomHats).use("hat").tags("drums", "hook")
keys: note(atoms.hh.boomChords).use("keys")
tagged("drums").mute(atoms.hh.intro)
tagged("drums").mute(atoms.hh.dropBar)
tagged("hook").mute(atoms.hh.verse)

syntax.title: Beat switch with gated racks
syntax.explain: one slot, two racks, the gate atom hh.switch decides
syntax.code:
setcpm(90/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/phonk:atoms-hiphop")
hooks.bind("kick", "bbKick", "<3b"); hooks.bind("kick", "knock808", "@3b"); hooks.bind("clap", "clap")
boom: s(atoms.hh.boomKick).use("kick").tags("boom")
trap: s(atoms.hh.trapKick).use("kick").tags("trap")
clap: s(atoms.hh.boomSnare).use("clap")
tagged("boom").mute("@3b")
tagged("trap").mute("<3b")
